items.title: M1 Lattice: Merging Guide
items.purpose: Provides exploratory guidance for combining M1 transport units. This document reflects early understanding and is expected to evolve with practical experience.

items.title: M1 Runtime Manual
items.purpose:
This document explains how to use the `m1` Python package as a runtime for loading, inspecting, editing, and re-emitting M1 data.

It is about programmer use of the runtime module. It does not describe the browser UI.

items.title: M1 Runtime API Outline
items.purpose: Outline the intended programmer-facing runtime model and API for working with loaded M1 documents, overlay edits, cache selection, sourcing, ordering, loading, and saving.

items.title: M1 Lattice: Transport Specification (Epoch 2)
items.purpose: Defines how M1 entities and aspects are represented for storage and exchange.

items.title: M1 Lattice: Recommended Link Types
items.purpose: Provides a shared set of commonly useful link types to promote consistency across M1 systems.

items.title: FileTalk File Transport Profile v1
items.purpose: One UTF-8 JSON message per uniquely named file; directory polling, incomplete-write retries, and removal after processing.
